record.action:
Provider and API error boundaries
Map timeout, non-2xx, missing output, invalid JSON/schema, database failure, invalid UUID, and validation failure
Criteria: F13; U8
record.conditions:
B01 source and locked dependencies.
Inspect: Shared provider, API error helper, five API route families, UI error extraction
record.expectedResult: Stable codes/statuses and learner-safe messages; raw provider/database detail is not returned to the UI; no implicit retry
record.actualResult: Shared provider explicitly has no retry (`llm-provider.ts:34`), central timeout (`:48`), and stable non-2xx/invalid/missing/timeout/network errors (`:75–104`). `api-error.ts:10` supplies the common envelope. Session/preference/detail/respond/follow-up routes map validation, not-found, conflict, scope, generation, and database failures to stable 400/404/409/422/502/500 responses. Raw provider/database detail is logged server-side but safe messages are returned. Runtime recovery presentation remains for later dynamic/usability evidence.
record.outcome: Pass for static contract; runtime UI recovery not assessed here
record.limitation: Static error contract only; runtime UI recovery is not assessed by this case.
